dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 友達作りのことで
dialogue.English: It's about making friends.

dialogue.content: はい、お友達作りについて、どのようにお悩みですか
dialogue.English: I see. In what way are you struggling with making friends?

dialogue.content: 親友はもちろん、一緒に遊びに行ってくれる友人が出来ないんです
dialogue.English: I can't seem to make any friends who will go out with me, let alone a best friend.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはおつらいですよね。いつもは、お一人ですごしていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be tough. So you usually spend your time alone, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何時ごろから、そのような寂しいきもちになったのですか
dialogue.English: Around when did you start feeling this loneliness?

dialogue.content: ここ２．３年ぐらいから
dialogue.English: For about the past two or three years.

dialogue.content: 食事や遊びに誘っても断られるんです
dialogue.English: Even when I invite people out for a meal or to hang out, I get turned down.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お辛いですね。二年、三年は長く感じられますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds painful. Two or three years can feel like a long time, can't it?

dialogue.content: SNSでは話が出来てもそれ以上は
dialogue.English: I can talk on social media, but beyond that...

dialogue.content: 続かないんです。
dialogue.English: it doesn't go any further.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。SNSならおはなしできるのですね。それ以上になると、続かない、、、んですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you can chat on SNS, but it doesn't progress further, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何で？って思ってモンモンとしてます
dialogue.English: I keep brooding, wondering, 'Why?'

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよね。。。相談者さんは何がお好きなんですか
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand that. What are some things you enjoy?

dialogue.content: 趣味です
dialogue.English: I mean your hobbies.

dialogue.content: 趣味はこれって特にないです
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular hobbies.

dialogue.content: 友達と遊びに行きたいし
dialogue.English: I want to go out with friends,

dialogue.content: 食事もしたいです
dialogue.English: and I want to have meals with them too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。遊びに行きたいですよね。ちなみに、お友達の好きなことについて、質問した事は
dialogue.English: I see. You want to go out and have fun. By the way, have you ever asked about what your friends enjoy?

dialogue.content: 質問ですか？
dialogue.English: Asked them questions?

dialogue.content: はい。何か興味をもって聞いていったり。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. Like showing interest and asking them about things...

dialogue.content: 話は普通に出来ていましたよ
dialogue.English: We used to talk normally.

dialogue.content: 学生の時とか
dialogue.English: Like when I was a student.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。楽しかったころのお友達は今つながってますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you still in touch with the friends from those enjoyable times?

dialogue.content: つながってない。切られてしまう。
dialogue.English: We're not in touch. They end up cutting me off.

dialogue.content: どうして？って思う
dialogue.English: I keep wondering, 'Why?'

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね。どうしてって、、、思いますよね
dialogue.English: I can really understand that. You'd naturally wonder why.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達はみな、忙しくしているのですか
dialogue.English: Are all of your friends busy?

dialogue.content: わからないです。
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 連絡先を自然に消されたりすると
dialogue.English: When they quietly delete my contact information...

dialogue.content: どうしてるのか踏み込めない
dialogue.English: I can't bring myself to ask them how they're doing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。一人だけ、取り残された感じに思えてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It feels like you're the only one left behind, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: そのようなお友達は、いったん離れて、、、
dialogue.English: With friends like that, perhaps it's best to take a step back for a while...

dialogue.content: 新しいお友達をつくる、、、ことを大切にされた方がよいように思いますが、、、
dialogue.English: I think it might be better to focus on making new friends...

dialogue.content: 初めから離れてます
dialogue.English: We're already distant from the start.

dialogue.content: いかがですか、、、
dialogue.English: How does that sound...?

dialogue.content: どのようにして作ったらいいですか？
dialogue.English: How should I go about making them?

dialogue.content: そうですか、、、ではまずは、外に出かけたときに、、、
dialogue.English: I see... Well, for a start, when you go out...

dialogue.content: 本やさんへ行ったり、買い物したときに、店員さんと仲良くなることから、、、
dialogue.English: you could try becoming friendly with the staff at a bookstore or a shop you go to...

dialogue.content: 店員さんはお食事したりするには随分ハードルが高いようにおもうのですが
dialogue.English: Getting to the point of having a meal with a shop assistant seems like a pretty high hurdle to me.

dialogue.content: ともだち、、、というより、気楽に話せる人を、たくさん作ることから。。。
dialogue.English: Rather than 'friends,' it's about starting by finding many people you can talk to casually...

dialogue.content: 気軽に話せる友達から先に進みたいのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like to move beyond casual acquaintances.

dialogue.content: お食事にいきたいのですね。。。
dialogue.English: You'd like to go out for meals, right...?

dialogue.content: SNSでははなせてますが、ダメなのですか？
dialogue.English: I can talk to them on social media, but is that not good enough?

dialogue.content: なるほど、、、SNSでもよいとおもいます。でも、お食事して人と関わりたいんですよね？
dialogue.English: I see... I think social media is fine. But you want to interact in person over meals, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。では、なにが一番よいか考えましょう。。。
dialogue.English: I understand... Well then, let's think about what the best approach would be.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: なにか、集いとか、習い事などはされてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you part of any groups or do you take any classes?

dialogue.content: してません
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: 全く関わりがないところからですね
dialogue.English: So you're starting from a point of having no connections at all.

dialogue.content: 仕事で時間がありません
dialogue.English: I don't have time because of work.

dialogue.content: お仕事もお忙しいのですね。仕事場の人間関係はいかがですか
dialogue.English: You're busy with work as well. How are your relationships at your workplace?

dialogue.content: みんなと一緒に話は楽しく出来てるけど、個人的には、言い訳されて断られます
dialogue.English: I can have fun talking with everyone as a group, but when it comes to one-on-one, they make excuses and turn me down.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。寂しいおもいになりますね。。。職場で気が合う人を見つけるところから、、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you feel lonely... Perhaps starting by finding someone you get along with at work...

dialogue.content: 一人でも出来るとよいですが、、、
dialogue.English: Even one person would be a good start...

dialogue.content: 気が合うとこちらは思ってるのに、何故か離れていく
dialogue.English: Even though I feel we get along, for some reason they drift away.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、、それは本当に辛すぎますよね。楽しく会話ができているのに断られるんですね、、、
dialogue.English: I see... That must be incredibly painful. You're having pleasant conversations, but you still get turned down...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 笑顔も自然と消えて行ってしまう感じですね
dialogue.English: It feels like your smile naturally fades away, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一人の孤独感って本当につらいですからね、、、
dialogue.English: The loneliness of being on your own is truly hard...

dialogue.content: 外で出会ったりする長く続く友人ってものが欲しいです
dialogue.English: I want long-lasting friends I meet out in the world.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。一人でもいいですからね。それが叶うといいですね
dialogue.English: I understand... Even just one would be great. I hope that wish comes true for you.

dialogue.content: 突然ですが、動物はすきですか？
dialogue.English: This is a bit sudden, but do you like animals?

dialogue.content: 動物もすきです
dialogue.English: I like animals too.

dialogue.content: 動物はとっても純粋で気持ちをいやしてくれますよ
dialogue.English: Animals are very pure and can be very healing.

dialogue.content: 動画とか見たりします。やっぱり友人が欲しいです
dialogue.English: I watch videos of them. But I still want human friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。少し整理させてくださいね。相談者さんはお友達をつくりたい、、、とおもってますね
dialogue.English: I see. Let me summarize a bit. You want to make friends, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、こちらから、関わろうとしても断られてしまう、、、
dialogue.English: But when you try to connect with people, you get turned down...

dialogue.content: SNSでも、職場でも楽しく会話はできているんだけど、それ以上の関係にはなれない
dialogue.English: You can have pleasant conversations on social media and at work, but the relationships don't develop any further.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お食事にも行きたい、、、というのが今のお気持ちですね。
dialogue.English: And you want to be able to go out for meals with them... that's how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とっても素直なきれいな心の相談者さんのようなので、勇気をほんの少し、、、出していきませんか
dialogue.English: You seem like someone with a very honest and pure heart, so how about mustering just a little courage?

dialogue.content: どのように？
dialogue.English: How?

dialogue.content: やはり、コミュニケーションをとることから始めなければ、何も始まらないので、、、
dialogue.English: After all, nothing can start unless we begin by communicating...

dialogue.content: 短い言葉から、そして笑顔の自分をみせていくことで、楽しそうな雰囲気をつくっていけるのでは、、、
dialogue.English: Perhaps by starting with short phrases and by showing a smiling face, you can create a fun atmosphere...

dialogue.content: 短い言葉って？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by short phrases?

dialogue.content: 挨拶はもちろんですが、目の前の人を褒める言葉ですね。。明るい人のところには、自然と。
dialogue.English: Greetings, of course, but also words of praise for the person in front of you. People are naturally drawn to cheerful individuals.

dialogue.content: 楽しそうな雰囲気じゃないってことですか？
dialogue.English: Are you saying I don't create a pleasant atmosphere?

dialogue.content: もっと楽しく、、、こころがけることです。
dialogue.English: It's about making a conscious effort to be more cheerful.

dialogue.content: そんな
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 明るい話ばかりの職場でもないので聞き役は多いです
dialogue.English: My workplace isn't always full of cheerful topics, so I often end up being the listener.

dialogue.content: 凄いですね！！！聞き役になれてのですね。ニコニコしてがんばっていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: That's amazing! You're able to be a good listener. You must be trying your best with a smile on your face.

dialogue.content: ニコニコはわからないですが、個人的になると
dialogue.English: I'm not sure about the smiling part, but when it becomes one-on-one...

dialogue.content: はい。個人的になると、、、
dialogue.English: Yes. When it becomes one-on-one...?

dialogue.content: またね、とか言われて、待っても連絡来なくなる
dialogue.English: They'll say things like, 'See you later,' but even if I wait, they never contact me.

dialogue.content: 他の人と変わらないのに
dialogue.English: Even though I'm no different from anyone else.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、、悲しいですね、、、いつも聞き役ばかりでは、本当の意味で楽しめないですね
dialogue.English: I see... that's sad... If you're always just the listener, you can't truly enjoy yourself, can you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, I can't.

dialogue.content: 落ち込んでしまうのも無理ないです
dialogue.English: It's understandable that you feel down.

dialogue.content: お友達って、同じ年代だけにしぼらず、、、
dialogue.English: As for friends, you don't have to limit yourself to people your own age...

dialogue.content: すみません！時間・・・
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm sorry! The time...

dialogue.content: はい！もっとお話しをききたいところでしたが、、、では、まとめますね。
dialogue.English: Yes! I would have liked to hear more, but let me summarize then.

dialogue.content: 過ぎていて。用事があるので
dialogue.English: It's gone over. I have somewhere to be.

dialogue.content: わかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
